corpus: Authored seed corpus for PasteWise, written for this hackathon. Not scraped production documents. Every date and amount appears verbatim in its source text so the deterministic verifier can check them.

rows.text: Your health insurance coverage will expire on 2026-12-15. To keep your benefits, renew by paying ETB 500 before the deadline. Bring your ID card and previous insurance card to the nearest health office. If you miss the deadline, your coverage will stop.

explanation.summary: Your health insurance is ending soon. You must renew it to keep your benefits.

actions.step: Renew your health insurance before 2026-12-15.
Pay ETB 500 to keep your coverage.
Bring your ID card and insurance card to the health office.

actions.step: Go to your appointment on 2027-01-20 at 10:00 AM.
Arrive 15 minutes early.
Bring your patient ID, insurance card, and medication list.

actions.step: Pay the school fees by 2026-10-05.
Pay the total of ETB 3,500.
Pay at the school office or by mobile money.

Pay ETB 50 at the office.

Bring your ID and this summons.
